test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The profit earned by selling a jacket for Rs. 3860 is equal to the loss incurred by selling the same jacket for Rs. 1900. What should be the selling price of the jacket to earn 10 percent profit?
solution:
Given:

The profit earned by selling the article at Rs. 3860 is the same as the loss incurred by selling the article for Rs. 1900

Formula:

Profit = SP – CP

Loss = CP &nd
